messages:
mike (finance): OrbitWave invoice INV-2026-4140 for $33,200 is still outstanding. Due date was 2026-03-01. We have no remittance. Can AE confirm status?

sam (acct-exec): Pinged Tanya at AP — they say treasury needs a PO number added to the remittance to match in their ERP. I just sent PO OW-5566 with a corrected invoice.

tanya (OrbitWave AP): Hi all 97 thanks. Procurement required PO on the wire ref. Treasury scheduled an ACH for tomorrow morning but asked if we can do a 50% partial now to avoid service hold.

mike (finance): We can accept 50% ($16,600) by 2026-03-20 09:00 UTC with masked confirmation to avoid immediate suspension. If full balance clears by 2026-03-21 EOD we'll waive the $250 reinstatement fee.

sam (acct-exec): Also offered a one-time operational credit of $300 if they pay in full by 03/21. @tanya please confirm acceptance so I can email the credit confirmation.

tanya (OrbitWave AP): OrbitWave accepts the $300 credit and will send 50% today and the rest tomorrow AM. I'll upload masked remittance once treasury issues the ACH.

jess (legal): Document the PTP in account notes. Per contract we can charge 1% monthly late fee if not paid; agreed waivers must be recorded. If the second tranche misses the date we'll start the 7-day demand letter timeline.

ops (platform): Heads-up: if we trigger a billing hold we'll throttle enterprise connectors and pause background jobs. I can prepare a re-enable checklist; I need TXN refs to reconcile.

collections-bot: Reminder: Billing hold for account "orbit-wave" scheduled 2026-03-20 09:00 UTC if outstanding balance > $0. Run `/payments check INV-2026-4140` to refresh.

mike (finance): Thanks. @sam paste masked remittance here when you have it and I'll clear the pending hold and send the $300 credit confirmation email. Leaving thread open until settlement. :white_check_mark:
